Definition: Does the government maintain a digital electoral register?
Comments: Benin uses the Liste électorale permanente informatisée (LEPI) and government communication describes RNPP as the single source for electoral data and digital platforms (including USSD) to consult/modify polling center, indicating a partially deployed digital electoral register.

Definition: Does the government maintain a digital land register?
Comments: Benin has an online national cadastre (cadastre.bj) operated by the National Estate and Land Agency (ANDF), and project documentation describes creation of an IT system (e-Foncier Benin) to store parcel/land administration data, indicating partial deployment of a digital land registry/cadastre.
